entries.source: Allakhazam 'Reaching Beyond' (Wayback 2004-10-14): swim at the base of the bridge until he 'pulled out the root', then 'give him the feather and the root' (a stat-less quest token)
entries.why: the step 3 search handed out nothing, though step 4 asks for the feather and the root; a stat-less token like the Basilisk Feather
the search step now hands out the root (a search step gives its StepItemTemplate on success, DataQuest.cs AdvanceQuestStep)

permanent world 'Feairna-athar' (level 60) 1.1k from The Lost Seed ambush point; the script spawns its own Feairna-Athar for step 5 and its name check is case-sensitive, so both stood and killing the world copy never advanced the quest
